content.stem: A line of best fit for data relating hours spent studying, $x$, and test score, $y$, for a group of students is $y = 4.5x + 62$. Based on this line, what is the predicted test score for a student who studied for $6$ hours?

distractorRationales.label: A
distractorRationales.text: This is the predicted score for $0$ hours of studying, the $y$-intercept.

distractorRationales.label: B
distractorRationales.text: This is the predicted score for $1$ hour of studying.

distractorRationales.label: C
distractorRationales.text: This adds $6$ to $62$ instead of multiplying $6$ by the slope.
